items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week practice no setbacks; missed prior 3 games on torn hamstring. Was Q.
items.why: Full practices, starter reps, no setbacks.
items.implication: QB1/streamer upgrade; boosts CHI pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Full snaps; elevated targets for Rome Odunze, DJ Moore if active, Colston Loveland.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot after doctor consultations; out for foreseeable future. Signed RB Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Blood clot; multiple doctor consults Saturday.
items.implication: Tanner McKee starts; Eagles pass-catchers retain value with healthy top-4.
items.opportunity: McKee QB streamer; elevated snaps/routes for DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after IR stint for high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Practiced limited all week; activated off IR.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 starter if active; high target share return.
items.opportunity: Primary routes/targets in NE offense vs Jets.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee anywhere needing QB; will be better than thought. Not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee. Start AJ Brown as WR2 if active.
items.why: McKee can play; skills healthy. AJB expected active.
items.implication: McKee stream; AJB start; Eagles WR/TE safe.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Probable-leaning: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle.
items.implication: Monitor AM for Brown/Henderson; start probables.
items.opportunity: If Henderson out, more Rhamondre/others; Metcalf heavy if thin WR.
items.conflict: Later Schefter confirmed Brown active/Caleb start.

items.text: Sunday injuries OUT include Lamar Jackson, Saquon Barkley, Jalen Hurts, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, Breece Hall, David Montgomery.
items.implication: Major role shifts for backups/handcuffs across multiple teams.
items.opportunity: Huntley for Lamar; Blue/Pierce for PHI RBs; Worthy/others for Rice; Tuten etc for Hall.

items.text: Sunday injuries IN: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix.
items.implication: Full roles restored; start with confidence.

items.text: QUESTIONABLE: AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson (among others including Caleb pre-update, DJ Moore, Tyler Warren, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Quinshon Judkins, Ja'Kobi Lane).
items.implication: Game-time; Henderson biggest uncertainty post high-ankle.
items.opportunity: If out, backups rise (e.g. for Henderson). Brown later ACTIVE.
items.conflict: Brown later confirmed active; Caleb start.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs Panthers.
items.implication: Thin PHI RB room with Shipley also out; McKee + pass-heavy.
items.opportunity: Carries/goal-line for Dameon Pierce or other backups.

items.text: PIT without WRs Michael Pittman, Roman Wilson, Ben Skowronek. Expect lots of 2-WR sets with DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard.
Tanner McKee has PHI 4th-string RB (Dameon Pierce) but top-4 pass-catchers healthy: DeVonta, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets funneled to top pass group.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense nightmare for pass catchers.
Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage; Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage + leaky run D. Also Javonte Williams @GB goal-line, Rhamondre vs NYJ.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (tough matchup), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT, Kyle Pitts vs CHI (shaky QB/feed); also JK Dobbins vs SEA, Bo Nix vs SEA, Justin Herbert @KC.
items.why: Ugly matchups, low totals, shaky roles.
